notes.title: Nintendo Switch version is almost ready - and it's good news for everyone!
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/InsignificantSillyAmazontreeboa-size_restricted.gif[/img]
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

It’s been quite a while since we shared the last piece of information about the X-Morph: Defense port for Nintendo Switch. We have an excuse for that, and it’s a good one - the game is almost ready! We spent the last couple of weeks working really hard to make the gaming experience on the Switch as smooth as possible. It has been an exciting process and we have also learned a lot from it. What follows is quite a detailed description of what’s been going on (there’s also a TL;DR version, just scroll down).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/l74CNe7.jpg[/img]
[b][i]We made sure to transfer the whole X-Morph: Defense experience to the Nintendo Switch.[/i][/b]

At first, we did not plan to develop X-Morph: Defense for the Nintendo Switch. Even though many people have been asking for it we just kept saying no. We were aware that porting the game to the Nintendo Switch would prove to be a challenge. Packing so much content and keeping the quality consistently high on mobile hardware is no easy feat. All the requests from players have stayed in the back of our minds and we finally decided to give it a try. So, in a sense, you have made it happen.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y1Fcqzc.jpg[/img]
[b][i]During the campaign, you will see all the levels, weapons and enemies known from the other versions.[/i][/b]

X-Morph: Defense is quite a demanding game even for the latest consoles. The amount of visual effects and physics calculations keeps all the processing cores saturated with work at 100% most of the time. Nintendo Switch is a significantly less powerful device due to its portable nature. It meant we had to optimize many elements while keeping the experience largely unchanged. Therefore, we set some goals for ourselves. Stable performance, no gameplay changes, the same level of destruction, in both docked and handheld modes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RfFHsGC.jpg[/img]
[b][i]The new towers are available with the base game at launch.[/i][/b]

Stable performance was the first one. Our aim was to achieve 30 frames per second both in handheld and docked mode. After we got the game up and running we began performance profiling to find problematic parts of the game. Through trial and error, we arrived at a stable 30FPS in 720p in handheld mode, without the visuals taking a big hit. Sure, we had to cut some props here and there and reduce some particle effects, but the game looks and plays great in handheld mode. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6eDjsME.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Our team has pushed the Switch hardware to its limits, EXOR never gives up on explosions![/i][/b]

As for the docked mode, we tried 1080p at first. An important fact here is that in 1080p the device has to render over twice as many pixels as in 720p. Unfortunately, the Switch does not become twice as fast in docked mode and the performance wasn’t satisfactory. Cutting objects from the game was out of the question since we didn’t want the handheld version to suffer. Therefore, we decided to reduce the resolution to 900p. Unfortunately, that wasn’t enough, so we also reduced the size of the post-processing buffer responsible for HDR bloom. The difference in rendering quality is negligible, but it gave us an extra 2-millisecond boost in frame rendering time that allowed us to equalize the handheld and docked performance.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5p5xoVa.jpg[/img]
[b][i]The gameplay is dynamic and responsive, as you have to constantly adapt to the types of enemies attacking your core.[/i][/b]

The gameplay itself is exactly what you saw in other versions of X-Morph: Defense. The number of enemies has not been reduced, all the missions are the same and all the levels play out exactly as you would expect them to. We had to reduce the amount of debris left by the enemies, but we compensate for that with added score multipliers, counting both for the resource gathering and the final score. Some maps have undergone cosmetic changes to reduce the strain on the hardware, but these changes have no effect on the gameplay.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aU0F7Ma.jpg[/img]
[b][i]The destructible environment has always been one of the biggest advantages of the game. Keeping this feature and maintaining performance required some clever trickery.[/i][/b]

The destructible environment was a big challenge. Buildings consisting of physical chunks require the device to render a huge amount of polygons and it was too much for Nintendo’s handheld. To combat that, we made custom, static versions of all physically simulated destructible objects in the game, which we swap for the dynamic versions once they are damaged. This saves up performance when it comes to the polygon count, but costs 90MB of system memory in our case. It is a lot. Nintendo Switch has a lot less memory on board than the PS4 or Xbox One. Just to get the game running we had to reduce memory usage by about 30%. Code optimization, texture size reduction, and sound compression got us there, but it was not a cakewalk. Memory fragmentation was one of the greatest issues, causing crashes and rendering the game unplayable. We fixed the stability by allocating static memory pools for the game components, such as sounds, particles, GUI, videos and save files. We eventually managed to stick to the limits. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NDBswln.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Even though we had to cut down on some visual effects, the game still looks gorgeous.[/i][/b]

The only gameplay feature we had to cut is the co-op mode. Our split-screen mode requires the device to render almost twice as many elements as in the single-player mode. It doesn’t mean that all calculations are done twice - the physics, AI, or pathfinding require only a single operation. Our experience from working with other platforms shows that split-screen requires about 30% more processing power. Such a number exists under the assumption that we have some spare CPU cores and we can use them to parallelize some calculations. We do not have this luxury on the Switch - we use 100% of resources at all times. It means we would have to cut down on some features and do a lot of extra work. This is why we decided to leave the split-screen out from the game for now. We do not rule it out in the future, but can’t promise anything at this point.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IVxTDrk.jpg[/img]
[b][i]The red-hot rivers of lava on Iceland are one of the most eye-catching features in X-Morph: Defense. [/i][/b]

We know that download sizes are a big concern in the Switch community. Through numerous optimizations, we have reduced the package size from over 4GB to just a little bit over 1.6GB. Among other things, we have used OGG Vorbis compression on our audio files and removed the 4K-ready textures, as they would never be utilized anyway. Moreover, this is the first release of the game on the Switch, meaning we do not need to keep older versions of the maps just to keep save files compatible. This way you will be able to have X-Morph: Defense installed alongside other games, without worrying about the free space on your device. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7Fl7LB0.jpg[/img]
[b][i]The boss fights remain as epic as ever.[/i][/b]

X-Morph: Defense will be available together with all the updates that were previously released on other platforms. It means that you will be able to enjoy the survival mode, additional tower types and all the little changes that happened over the course of the game’s lifetime. All the pieces of premium DLC will be available for purchase day one. We also do not raise the cost of the game - it will be around the $20 price point, with currency-specific adjustments.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BfTF4c5.jpg[/img]
[b][i]Tricking your enemies into taking a suboptimal route is very important. The control scheme remained unchanged, so you have perfect control over the battlefield.[/i][/b]

Last, but not the least important is the release date. We wanted the game to be released before the end of 2018. The reality has verified our plans, but the delay is not that big. X-Morph: defense will become available on Nintendo eShop in very early 2019. We are also looking into releasing a physical edition of the game - we will share more info about this as soon as everything is 100% confirmed.

And finally - TL;DR:
[list]
[*]Very early 2019.
[*]The base game has all the free updates that were previously released on other platforms.
[*]All DLC available for purchase at launch.
[*]720p/30FPS handheld, 900p/30FPS docked.
[*]All gameplay features including fully destructible environments and building physics remain except split-screen co-op.
[*]1.6GB install size.
[*]$20 price point with currency-specific adjustments (check Steam pricing for reference).
[*]No gameplay changes.
[*]Digital download from Nintendo eShop.
[*]We’re looking into physical release options.
[/list]

Developing the Nintendo Switch version has been a challenge, pointing out problems we did not know about and allowing us to optimize the game beyond what we imagined. All the optimizations will also find their way onto other platforms with future patches. This way our fans can enjoy improved performance on all devices. We hope you’ll have as much fun playing it as we had working on it.

Let us know if you have any further questions!
EXOR Studios

notes.title: Update 1.12 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ClutteredScrawnyLeopard-size_restricted.gif[/img]
We've just released the latest maintenance update which primarily focuses on fixing bugs that were introduced in the Last Bastion DLC as well as some quality of life improvements.

[h1]Change list[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a custom minimap icon for the Tortuga shield generator,
[*]Updated Indonesia map in the Last Bastion DLC - more props, more destructible objects, additional underwater detail, fixed Vulture gunships firing rockets from outside the visible area of the map
[*]Fixed a cutscene bug in the Russia level in the main story campaign when infantry survived the flame tower intro,
[*]Fixed a cutscene bug in the Madagascar level in the Last Bastion DLC which caused the Vulture gunships cutscene to block player controls,
[*]Easter Island - fixed enemy units driving outside the visible gameplay area,
[*]Easter Island - fixed navigation grid on one of the bridges that prevented enemy units from driving over it,
[*]Iceland  - fixed enemy units driving outside the visible gameplay area,
[*]Fixed Ravager missile launcher starting positions across the Last Bastion DLC,
[*]Fixed a possible crash on startup caused by some Chinese audio driver name configurations,
[*]Fixed audio device detection on startup which caused a lack of sound on some audio driver configurations,
[/list]

We'd also like you to know that we are hearing your feedback about the Survival mode. We are currently working on a solution to save progress during the game and further balance the gameplay on Hard and Brutal difficulty modes. We will let you know how this turns out in future updates.

notes.title: Last Bastion DLC is now available + Huge Free Update, New Towers!
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AnxiousWigglyBarnowl-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Hi Everyone,

We are proud to announce that the third DLC for X-Morph: Defense - Last Bastion is now available! Check out the new trailer for The Last Bastion below:
https://youtu.be/z6yT2fDHJTQ
“Last Bastion” features a brand new, story-driven mini-campaign that takes place after the events of the main game. The action take place on 4 islands, each with unique features. Chop down massive baobab trees in the Madagascar, slalom among the Moai on Easter Island, reshape the environment in sunny Indonesia and try not to melt in rivers of lava on Iceland. 4 new enemy types round up the package, ensuring that the X-Morph: Defense storyline gets the finale it deserves.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/800342/XMorph_Defense__Last_Bastion/

[h1]New Stuff!!![/h1]
Together with the DLC, we are also releasing a huge free update to the base game that adds [b]new advanced tower types[/b] and multiple improvements. 

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/GlamorousHeftyAzurevase-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[b]The full list of changes includes:[/b][list]
[*]3 new towers:
[b]- Railgun tower[/b] - a powerful advanced laser tower that can shoot through enemies and environmental obstacles.
[b]- Flame Artillery tower[/b] - an advanced artillery tower that shoots three projectiles that ignite everything they hit.
[b]- Shockwave tower[/b] - an advanced tower type that emits powerful shockwaves which deal damage to all enemies within its radius.
These towers are available in all game modes including the main story campaign and survival mode. They change a lot in how you can play the game. Their addition makes a new playthrough definitely worthwhile.
[*]4 new enemy types:
[b]- Vulture Gunship[/b]
[b]- Manticore EMP tank[/b]
[b]- Ravager missile launcher[/b]
[b]- Tortuga shield generator[/b]
[*]Added all Last Bastion content to the Level Editor. You can use the new textures, buildings, and enemies inside your levels. The resulting creations won’t require other players to own the Last Bastion DLC.
[*]Added audio compression for music and voice-overs resulting in a ~1.5GB smaller game installation size.
[*]Optimized memory usage.
[*]Multiple obscure crash bug fixes.
[*]Slight performance improvements.
[*]Fixed audio problems on some speaker configurations (too much bass).
[/list]

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ClutteredScrawnyLeopard-size_restricted.gif[/img]
We hope this new update will be as fun for you to play as it was for us to develop. It is a real pleasure to develop new features and we are always open to your feedback. Let us know if you like the game on our social media channels and discord server! 

Thank you for your support!
EXOR Studios

notes.title: ANNIVERSARY UPDATE! NEW TOWERS! NEW ENEMIES!
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ScarceIncompatibleArcticfox-max-14mb.gif[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

In just a little over one month we will celebrate the first anniversary of X-Morph: Defense’s release! In order to make the event a little more special we are currently working on a set of new features that we will add to the game at the end of August! The things we are working on can be divided into three major parts.

First of all, we finally caved in to your requests for more variety and we’re introducing [b]new towers[/b]! With the anniversary update you will be able to upgrade the current laser tower, flamethrower tower and artillery tower even further, much like the AA flak tower. The upgrades are more powerful, but more specialized than the ones you are used to using now. They will be balanced to be used alongside existing tower types - we don’t want to make the older towers obsolete. The new toys will often require strategic placement in order to be used effectively. We will share all the details with you as soon as we get all the gears running and plasma flowing. Oh, and one more thing - [b]the new towers will come to all of you as a free content update.[/b]

With the new weapons comes the need for some decent targets. That is why we’re adding  [b]four new types of enemies[/b] to the game - one new flyer and three ground units. They will test your mettle and strategic planning skills in all new ways. They will not appear in the base game, as that would turn all the levels upside down, but you’re all free to use them while creating your own maps in the level editor. 

The place where you will be able to see the new units in their natural habitat is the [b]third DLC.[/b] This time we are going to deliver another story campaign to you, taking place after the events from the base game. The remnants of human forces have escaped to [b]four remote locations,[/b] and your task is to eradicate all the resistance. They will put up a fight!

If you would like to learn a little more about the new features you can check out the VOD of the stream we did on the 19/07/2018. We have a chat about the new content around the 1 hour 20 minutes mark. Make sure to follow this page and our other social media channels as we will publish sneak peaks of all the features regularly.

https://youtu.be/cFSuB7GJjF4

Thank you for this year of amazing support! We hope we can share more exciting moments together, so take a look at our social media channels and stay tuned for more news. Also, join us every Tuesday and Thursday at 2:30 PM GMT+2 on our streams. You can get your questions answered right away! See you there!

notes.title: Summer Update is LIVE
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ElderlyFriendlyChihuahua-max-14mb.gif[/img]
[h1]Commanders![/h1]

The time has come and the long-awaited [b]Survival Mode update[/b] is finally here! After careful testing and taking all your suggestions into consideration, we have made several changes to the way we handle Survival Mode in [b][i]X-Morph: Defense[/i][/b]. The [b]timer has been reworked,[/b] allowing the players whether they would like to earn extra points for skipping countdown or strategize during the intermission a bit longer. We also [b]updated some of the maps,[/b] adjusting early waves and resources available.

[b]The difficulty levels have been renamed[/b] and their descriptions updated. This way we can prepare the players better for the challenges ahead, avoiding unnecessary confusion. We hope this will smoothen the new player experience and make the learning curve a bit less steep for our users.

https://youtu.be/amWyrVR15xA

Along with these changes [b]we are releasing a new DLC[/b] - [b][i]Survival of the Fittest![/i][/b] You can put the new features and your skills to the test on [b]5 new maps,[/b] designed with the specifics of the Survival Mode in mind. Revisit reworked South Africa, Great Britain, France, Netherlands and Finland. The last three maps also feature the unique defensive measures used by the humans, known from the European Assault DLC. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rvx7ecI.jpg[/img]

Please note that the balance changes are global - [b]all X-Morph: Defense players will be able to enjoy the enhanced Survival Mode experience, [/b]regardless of the purchased DLCs - those stay entirely optional. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/800341/XMorph_Defense__Survival_Of_The_Fittest/

[b]The full changelog for this update is:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed countdown timer in Survival Mode. Enemy waves don’t start automatically on the Easy and Normal difficulty modes allowing infinite setup time. Hard and Brutal difficulty modes are unchanged. This change does not affect leaderboard scoring.
[*]Renamed difficulty modes: Very Easy = Easy, Easy = Normal, Normal = Hard, Hard = Brutal.
[*]Updated Survival Mode maps. Starting waves are now generally easier to defeat.
[*]Fixed a few very rare crash bugs.
[*]Balanced base levels in some audio samples.
[*]Added Nvidia Highlights Support.
[*]Updated Main Menu to accommodate new DLC.
[*]mproved mission failed tips.
[/list]

In our efforts to improve X-Morph: Defense we are constantly monitoring your feedback and considering all the suggestions that you make. We are extremely grateful to our community for being so helpful and patient and we hope we can deliver more great content that fully meets your expectations. Feel free to post on Steam forums and contact us on our social media channels if you have any feedback about the game. 

P.S.
This update and DLC is also coming to the PS4 and Xbox One. 

P.P.S.
Follow us on our social media channels to stay updated!

notes.title: Summer Update Public Beta this weekend!
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/SimilarEuphoricGermanspaniel-max-14mb.gif[/img]
Hi everyone!

We have decided to do a little bit more testing on the survival mode balance update and we need your help!

If you would like to see the gameplay changes we've talked about in action you may do so by joining a public beta we're holding this weekend. Note that the beta will only affect the survival mode gameplay.

To access the Beta build follow these steps:
1. Select X-Morph: Defense in your Steam Library
2. Right Click on it and select Properties
3. Switch to the BETA tab
4. Select "beta_survival Survival Mode Open Beta" from the drop-down list
5. The download should start after you close the properties window
Note: If the beta_survival is not visible in your BETA tab, then please restart Steam and check once more.

[b]The full changelog for this update is:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed countdown timer in Survival Mode. Enemy waves don’t start automatically on the Easy and Normal difficulty modes allowing infinite setup time. Hard and Brutal difficulty modes are unchanged. This change does not affect leaderboard scoring.
[*]Renamed difficulty modes: Very Easy = Easy, Easy = Normal, Normal = Hard, Hard = Brutal.
[*]Updated Survival Mode maps. Starting waves are now generally easier to defeat.
[*]Fixed a few very rare crash bugs.
[*]Balanced base levels in some audio samples.
[*]Added Nvidia Highlights Support.
[*]Updated Main Menu to accommodate new DLC.
[*]improved mission failed tips.
[/list]

notes.title: X-Morph: Defense - Summer Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ThatHeavyAracari-max-14mb.gif[/img]
[h1]Greetings, Commanders![/h1]

The release of the European Assault DLC in March was accompanied by the introduction of an all-new Survival game mode. It allowed our players to experience the [b][i]X-Morph: Defense[/i][/b] gameplay in a different fashion, without the full information and with more constraints, making for a refreshing change from the base X-Morph formula.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/YellowRewardingCaimanlizard-max-14mb.gif[/img]

Ever since we released the update we have been monitoring the feedback from you. Although most of you seemed to enjoy it, there were numerous requests to lower the difficulty in some way. We agree that the survival mode was geared towards the hardcore crowd, punishing people who prefer a more relaxed style of gameplay. That is why with the upcoming update we have decided on some changes to the survival experience.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HonoredBigLangur-max-14mb.gif[/img]

[b][i]The function of the intermission timer will be changed.[/i][/b] One of the most frustrating aspects for most of you was the limited time between waves. While some people were able to use it to get more points by skipping the countdown, most felt pressured into making  not optimal decisions. With the new update [b][i]as the timer runs out, the next wave WILL NOT start until you decide you are ready.[/i][/b] This way the score-oriented players can still gather more points by skipping countdowns, while the rest can no longer worry about the time pressure and focus on creating an effective defensive strategy.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ScarceFrenchArabianoryx-max-14mb.gif[/img]

[b][i]The difficulty levels have been renamed.[/i][/b] We have realized that our ‘normal’ difficulty level was quite difficult for most people and ‘very easy’ was not a popular choice as it does not feel rewarding to play on such low difficulty. [b][i]The new difficulty level names we are introducing are: easy, normal, hard and brutal.[/i][/b] There are no changes in the existing balance, so there is no need to restart the game. However, the game will now default to what used to be the ‘easy’ setting, and existing campaigns will update to new names, so if you started playing on ‘normal’, the game will now display ‘hard’ as the difficulty level, but there will be no changes to gameplay. The descriptions will be updated, allowing for a more informed choice of the style of gameplay you strive for. We hope that these changes will make the experience more welcoming for new players.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/IllfatedWillingAmericanavocet-max-14mb.gif[/img]

‘What are all those maps on the gifs?’ you might be asking. With the changes mainly being focused around the survival mode, we are proud to announce [b][i]a new DLC map pack called - Survival Of The Fittest. [/i][/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/800341/XMorph_Defense__Survival_Of_The_Fittest

It features 5 maps, adjusted to the survival gameplay, with new enemy setup and refreshed looks. The DLC is optional and will cost [b][i]$4.99.[/i][/b]We believe it will bring you hours of gameplay in those exciting environments.With that being said, we are also working on a new story DLC, but more news on that later.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/PracticalJealousBantamrooster-max-14mb.gif[/img]

As always we are eagerly waiting for your feedback and hope that the changes we made will cater to the needs of all our players. We make games for you and thus all your suggestions are carefully considered.

Thank you for your never-ending support
EXOR Studios

notes.title: Laser Weapon Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HollowUnitedIndri-max-14mb.gif[/img]

Hello!

We hope you are enjoying all the brand-new content we’ve released this week. Whether you’re invading Europe or trying to withstand the enemy onslaught in the survival mode, you are given a plethora of weapons to choose from.

Unfortunately, not all weapons are created equal. We have received a lot of consistently unfavorable feedback about the laser gun.  This weapon was supposed to be used against heavily armored opponents, dealing massive damage per second and increasing over time up to a cap. This comes at the cost of having to keep the laser on the target and leaving yourself vulnerable to enemy attacks.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AshamedZestyEstuarinecrocodile-max-14mb.gif[/img]

Even though the laser has gone through several iterations during development (there was no aiming aid, for example), we agree that it has been the most underpowered weapon in the X-Morph arsenal. After considering all the feedback from our fans, the latest version of the game comes with a major overhaul of this classic weapon. 

BEHOLD! LET THERE BE LIGHTNING!

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ImmenseTeemingKingbird-max-14mb.gif[/img]

In order to make using the laser more satisfying, we have made the beam wider (dual purpose - makes targeting easier and looks cool) and introduced chain damage. It comes in the form of lightning beams, targeting clusters or lines of foes nearest to the main target. This way you no longer have to deal with unharmed enemies with a ton of HP one by one - they are softened a bit. Also, groups of small enemies can be dealt with effectively, without the need to switch the weapon on the fly. 

We hope these tweaks will be helpful to your quest of achieving world domination.  


EXOR Studios

This weapon was supposed to be used against heavily armored opponents, dealing massive damage per second and increasing over time up to a cap. This comes at the cost of having to keep the laser on the target and leaving yourself vulnerable to enemy attacks.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AshamedZestyEstuarinecrocodile-max-14mb.gif[/img]

Even though the laser has gone through several iterations during development (there was no aiming aid, for example), we agree that it has been the most underpowered weapon in the X-Morph arsenal. After considering all the feedback from our fans, the latest version of the game comes with a major overhaul of this classic weapon. 

BEHOLD! LET THERE BE LIGHTNING!

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ImmenseTeemingKingbird-max-14mb.gif[/img]

In order to make using the laser more satisfying, we have made the beam wider (dual purpose - makes targeting easier and looks cool) and introduced chain damage. It comes in the form of lightning beams, targeting clusters or lines of foes nearest to the main target. This way you no longer have to deal with unharmed enemies with a ton of HP one by one - they are softened a bit. Also, groups of small enemies can be dealt with effectively, without the need to switch the weapon on the fly. 

We hope these tweaks will be helpful to your quest of achieving world domination.

notes.title: Update 1.05 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/SafeColossalHydatidtapeworm.gif[/img]

The promised update is finally here! Check out the full list of changes below:

Changelog 1.05:
- Added Hungarian language support,
- Added leaderboard score comparisons - you will know how well you did in comparison to your friends,
- Improved minimap readability,
- Upgraded boss health bars,
- Faster game loading time,
- Minor performance optimizations.
- Fixed multiple crash bugs,
- Fixed calculating score for playtime,
- Disabled double music playback in music volume change settings, 
- Fixed mouse latency issues,
- Fixed language setting in the X-Morph launcher,
- Fixed a few bugs on the statistics menu screen, 
- Fixed zip archive crashes - it is now possible to repackage game .zip files with any archiving tool like, e.g., 7zip 
- Fixed a few minor sound glitches
- Level Editor - additional Windows 7 fixes, improved stability

As we've mentioned before, we are continuously working on new content and improvements to X-Morph: Defense. The next maintenance update is going to include a Very Easy difficulty setting, and NVIDIA ShadowPlay highlights support. In the long term, we are working on a new game mode and an additional mini-campaign DLC.

We are also working on improving the Level Editor to make it usable for more people. We are entirely aware that it lacks a good tutorial and that it is not very stable. These are also the main reasons why we don't list it as a game feature on the store page yet. We hope to get things moving within the next few weeks. Until then we will keep you posted on our progress with regular updates.

notes.title: Update 1.04 is now live - improved game stability, Level Editor working on Windows 7 and more...
notes.notes:
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/AcademicBleakCamel.gif[/img]

Changelog 1.04:
- fixed many PhysX related crashes,
- fixed a few rare crash bugs,
- fixed many problems with the Mechataur boss,
- fixed achievements in coop mode,
- fixed move tower exploit,
- fixed APCs moving through destructible objects during unit deployment,
- added a custom sound when there are enough resources to build a new tower,
- fixed problems with the borderless window on the left monitor.

Level Editor improvements:
- added Windows 7 support,
- fixed multiple crash bugs,
- official Story Campaign maps can now be opened,
- new map browser.

Thank you for your patience and for reporting all of these bugs. Your feedback helped us to clean up a lot of these problems much faster. We will continue to work on fixing any outstanding bugs and issues that are reported by the community.

The Level Editor still has a lot of outstanding issues and problems, but it should be a lot more usable with this update. We are aware that the lack of any sensible tutorial makes using it very hard. Right now we've enabled you to study the officially released maps and to modify them. There's even a working prototype of a "pure tower defense" game mode in the Canada level. You can launch it by starting the game from the "tower_defense" start point. We hope to release a few more updates to the Level Editor during next week.

notes.title: Update 1.01 is now live.
notes.notes:
Changes included in this patch:
- Added Level Editor (BETA - Windows 7 currently not supported in the editor)
- Turned on Steam Workshop support
- KB2670838 Windows Update for Windows 7 is no longer required
- Added support for borderless window mode
- Fixed restricted player movement in super wide panoramic resolutions
- Fixed "physx::ProjectionPlaneProperty" crash
- Fixed some minor typos in English localization
- Fixed crashes for certain rare CPUs

 This update includes a bunch of hot fixes for most commonly reported problems. We've also included a BETA version of our X-Morph Level Editor with Steam Workshop support. The editor is still very unpolished and unstable so we didn't want to advertise it on the main Product Store Page yet. However, we know that a lot of you want to tinker with the game, play with the destructibility and check out our engine's capabilities. We are very excited to see what you create :) 

P.S. - Level Editor tutorial notes are coming tomorrow.

notes.title: Release date set to August 30th!
notes.notes:
[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/NegativeHollowBird.gif[/img]
We are finally ready to announce that X-Morph: Defense is going to release on August 30th. We've prepared a special release date announcement trailer for this occasion:
https://youtu.be/5uAuXjJZVjE

X-Morph: Defense is translated into English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese. All audio dialog is spoken in English.

Today is exactly the 10th anniversary of founding EXOR Studios on the 1st of August 2007. Since that day we've created D.I.P.R.I.P., Zombie Driver and now we are bringing you X-Morph: Defense. We've traveled a long way since our humble beginnings. We started as a group of modders working out of an apartment with zero funding. Today we are getting ready to launch our latest game simultaneously on the PC and consoles. We've achieved that with our Schmetterling engine. It's been a magnificent journey for all of us, and we wouldn't be here without you. Thank you for your continuing support!
